prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a locked character master sprite for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Output exactly 1024x1536 portrait, genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Reference images: trolloc-master.png is the LOCKED house style reference; riley-master.png is the human rendering and relative scale reference. Match both EXACTLY in confident dark brown/near black ink contours, thicker silhouette and thinner internal lines, clean 2-3 step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, grounded rich colors, hand-drawn HD 2D fighting game art in the spirit of Streets of Rage 4. Match Riley's human facial rendering. Do not copy reference backgrounds.
Subject: ONE ordinary HUMAN Jaret Byar, Child of the Light, adult male about 40, tall and GAUNT, lean hard bony build, a head taller than Riley when standing beside him, not muscular like Riley. Long bony face, hollow cheeks, deep-set dark burning eyes, thin unsmiling mouth, chin raised stern zealot glare. Close-cropped dark hair grey at temples. No helmet.
Clothing: long WHITE cloak with mud and rain stains at hem, white tabard over polished steel breastplate, large golden SUNBURST on anatomical left breast with TWO small golden rank knots directly below it. Steel pauldrons, grey mail sleeves, steel gauntlets and greaves, brown leather boots. White fabric with restrained warm grey shadows.
Pose: full body head to boots in side / slight three-quarter view FACING LEFT. Ready combat stance with bent knees and firm spread feet. Anatomical LEFT arm carries a raised white kite shield in front facing toward viewer-left, large golden sunburst and gilded steel rim, pointed bottom. Anatomical RIGHT hand visibly grips a long straight steel LONGSWORD, held HIGH behind the shield near shoulder/head height; sword blade directed diagonally upward toward LEFT, gilded straight crossguard. Clear plausible arms, wrists and five-finger gauntlet grip. Shield and sword must be coherent rigid objects, no bent or double blades, consistent sizes and shapes. Shield must not obscure his whole face or left-breast insignia. Make the entire sword, cloak, shield and boots fit inside canvas with clear margin.
Scale: keep head and equipment detail at Riley's sprite scale as closely as canvas permits; communicate Byar's greater standing height with long lean adult proportions rather than enlarging his head. Whole figure inside canvas.
Lighting: soft upper LEFT key, gentle cool rim on RIGHT edge, moderate baked shading for game lighting. Kid-friendly theatrical villain, no blood.
No background whatsoever: real alpha transparency, no black or white backdrop, no glow, no ground shadow, no floor, no text, labels, borders, frame numbers. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photoreal, not chibi.

Edit the supplied Byar image into the final locked game sprite. Keep his face, costume, ink line weight, cel shading, colors, sword length and straight shape, kite shield dimensions and shape unchanged. Output 1024x1536 portrait with REAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. REMOVE ALL backdrop, all dark gradients and all glow: every pixel outside the character and equipment must be transparent, including holes between limbs. No floor or shadow. This is mandatory.
Correct pose: facing LEFT in a more side-on three-quarter combat guard. His anatomical LEFT shield arm must extend forward toward viewer LEFT with the white kite shield raised in front of his torso, toward the opponent on the left. His anatomical RIGHT sword hand stays HIGH behind the shield, on the rear/right side of the torso near his right shoulder, holding the same straight longsword diagonally upward toward left. Show a coherent gauntlet grip and two anatomically correct arms. Keep his entire stern gaunt face readable above the shield. Keep the left-breast sunburst and two rank knots visible where possible. His chin is raised and his dark eyes glare LEFT. Keep long lean human proportions, grey temples, white cloak muddy hem, steel armor and brown boots.
Whole sword tip and boots and cloak inside frame with at least 35 pixels clear margin. Preserve the locked reference house style: confident thick near-black silhouette inks, thinner internal inks, 2-3 cel tones and subtle painterly gradients, moderate upper-left light and gentle cool right rim. No text. ONE full-body human only.
